description: The plot illustrates an ablation study on the HateXplain dataset, comparing different model variants across three evaluation metrics. The x-axis is labeled "Model Variants" and displays categorical values representing different configurations: "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The y-axis is labeled "Metric (%)" and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 58 to 66 at intervals of 2. The "Precision" metric is represented by a solid purple line with circle markers; it starts at 65.45 for the "Full model (Ours)", drops to 61.06 for "w/o Prompt", and then steadily increases across the remaining variants, reaching 62.22 for "w/o Augmentation", 64.06 for "w/o Attention", and ending at 65.44 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The "Recall" metric is shown as a solid blue line with circle markers, beginning at its peak of 65.78 for the "Full model (Ours)", decreasing sharply to 59.64 for "w/o Prompt", rising to 63.75 for "w/o Augmentation", and then declining through 59.17 for "w/o Attention" to end at its lowest point of 56.82 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". Finally, the "F1-score" metric is depicted by a solid brown line with circle markers, starting at a high of 65.56 for the "Full model (Ours)", falling to 60.16 for "w/o Prompt", increasing to 62.63 for "w/o Augmentation", and subsequently decreasing to 59.67 for "w/o Attention" before ending at 57.74 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation".
